faces.north-west front (55): evidence: ref-nw-a.jpg and ref-nw-b.jpg (finished facade). Row heights and the wide/slit change between storeys read from them; the mix of wide and slit windows inside one storey (wide on the left, slits on the right in the photo) is simplified to whole-storey bands.
faces.tower north/east, south-west (37, 167, 3: evidence: ref-tower-*.jpg, ref-sw*.jpg (site hoardings hide the ground floors).

caveats: The photographs show an open double-height portico under the tower and a glazed ground storey; the 3DBAG shell is closed to the ground there and no see-through opening was invented.
Individual window widths inside a storey vary on the building; the model uses one wide and one slit module.
No architect or building name was confirmed, hence ordinary.
